categories.name: amd-soc
categories.description: AMD/Xilinx SoC blocks for ARM-FPGA partitioning and AXI communication

customDescriptions.value: Read data from the FPGA fabric via an AXI4 memory-mapped interface — use to receive processed results or status registers from HDL IP running on the programmable logic
Write data to the FPGA fabric via an AXI4 memory-mapped interface — use to send parameters or commands from the processor to HDL IP running on the programmable logic
Read streaming data from the FPGA fabric via AXI4-Stream with Linux IIO — use for high-throughput continuous data transfer from PL to PS such as ADC sample streams
Write streaming data to the FPGA fabric via AXI4-Stream with Linux IIO — use for high-throughput continuous data transfer from PS to PL such as DAC output streams
Library identification label — internal library element, not used in application models
Execute a subsystem as a Linux process task on the ARM core of an AMD/Xilinx SoC — use to partition algorithms that run on the processor side of a Zynq or Versal device
Receive UDP datagrams on the SoC processor — use for network communication with a host PC or other networked devices
Send UDP datagrams from the SoC processor — use for telemetry or data transfer to a host PC over Ethernet
Execute a subsystem as a VxWorks task on the processor core — use when the AMD SoC runs VxWorks RTOS instead of Linux
